title: Taxonomy Schema
description: Defines the structure of taxonomic reference data. Taxonomy is the authoritative roster of organisms with formal classification, independent of any phylogenetic hypothesis.

taxonomy.description: Array of taxonomic records. Each taxon has a stable ID, scientific name, and parent relationship.

id.description: Stable taxonomic identifier. Always prefixed with 'tax_' to distinguish from phylogenetic node IDs. Does not depend on scientific name and remains unchanged through taxonomic revisions.

scientificName.description: Current scientific name (binomial for species, genus for genus, etc.). May change without changing the ID.

commonName.description: Common name in English, if available. Optional.

rank.description: Taxonomic rank (e.g., species, genus, family, etc.). Accepts any non-empty string. Common values include domain, kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, subfamily, tribe, subtribe, superfamily, genus, subgenus, species, subspecies, and many others from the Open Tree of Life taxonomy (infraorder, parvorder, cohort, section, no rank, etc.). Original rank strings from source taxonomies are preserved exactly.

parent.description: ID of parent taxon (e.g., 'tax_homo' for genus Homo). Root taxa have parent=null. Parent must exist in the taxonomy.

synonyms.description: Alternative scientific names (former names after reclassification, etc.). Optional.

source.description: Authority source (e.g., 'ITIS', 'NCBI', 'WoRMS'). Required for data provenance.

sourceId.description: Stable identifier in source system (e.g., ITIS TSN). Optional but recommended.

extinct.description: True if confirmed extinct, false if confirmed extant, null if status is unknown.

notes.description: Any additional notes or caveats. Optional.

license.description: License under which data is available. Required for redistribution verification.

accessDate.description: Date data was accessed or imported (YYYY-MM-DD). Required for version tracking.

version.description: Source version or snapshot identifier. Optional.

notes.description: Additional notes about data curation or processing. Optional.
